single_candidate: V2 root_pitch36 tip_twist_minus8; retain as a diagnostic candidate, not optimum; no additional pitch sweep or geometric variant before same-Q loaded points
candidate_rationale: Reducing pitch lowers nominal loading; current common free-point result trades -26.98% power for -7.14% flow and -21.39% total pressure. At the selected cooling objective its pressure capacity must be checked rather than assuming power reduction is efficiency. Current fine instability is near tip/trailing wake, not a reason to alter the root pitch until numerical and outlet effects are separated.

original_physical_assumptions.model: steady incompressible RANS kOmegaSST MRF, first-order convection; geometry, bearings, wall layers, scale and installed thermal conditions unqualified

hypothetical_cooling_objective.basis: Analyst-defined comparative hydraulic objective only; not a Porsche specification, norm, measured engine demand or manufacturing acceptance limit

pressure_definition: Outlet minus inlet area-mean static pressure on the fixed study ports; additionally retain signed-flux total-pressure rise and mechanical-energy terms as separate quantities. No claim of standardized AMCA fan static pressure or qualified efficiency.

system_resistance_hypotheses.provenance: Explicit analyst-selected bounded scenarios, not an OEM curve
system_resistance_hypotheses.intersection_policy: Interpolate only between numerically admitted sampled points, report all intersections and ranges; no extrapolation or rated engine performance claim

common_testbench.velocity_inlet: flowRateInletVelocity, prescribed positive volumetricFlowRate into domain; same declared uniform profile for both candidates
common_testbench.pressure_inlet: fixedFluxPressure compatible with prescribed velocity; no simultaneous imposed inlet total-pressure value
common_testbench.outlet: fixed static gauge pressure 0, pressureInletOutletVelocity permits backflow; monitor gross reverse flux
common_testbench.comparison_policy: Match Q, geometry envelope, ports, RPM, fluid, turbulence and solver settings; preserve input hashes and every gate; previous free-inlet-pressure points are not appended to this new inlet-profile curve
metrics: Q net and gross reverse flux
area-mean static and signed-flux total pressure rise
fluid pressure/viscous torque and torque*Omega input power
pressure/kinetic/swirl energy port terms and unclosed balance
original convergence and full finite-field gates
common_testbench.efficiency_policy: Compare P only at the same achieved Q and pressure objective; Q*Delta_p/P remains a defined numerical port metric until energy/model and physical validation are established

gates.mesh: Both independent standard and extended checkMesh, unchanged thresholds
gates.solver_acceptance: All original frozen residual, mass, stability, direction and finite-field criteria; no relaxation of pressure threshold
gates.history_retention: Original tables remain hash-identical. Freeze complete tables and manifests before exports and postprocess an analysis clone; verify cadence before computing statistics.
gates.no_ranking_if: Unadmitted sample, unbracketed objective, missing history, materially changed boundary testbench or unqualified grid/model response
gates.measurement_window: Require at least 20 native samples at consecutive actual solver iterations; checkpoint cadence 150 is independent of telemetry cadence 1; missing or sparse windows reject admission.

resource_batches_before_launch.purpose: Paired 60-iteration branches from the same V2/900 checkpoint, control pressure relTol .01 vs relTol0 with absolute tolerance1e-8 unchanged; pressure relaxation.15, same mesh/BC/physics/gates; preserve full histories and matrix/residual diagnostics if supported
resource_batches_before_launch.launch_state: not launched; requires coordinated Kali2 window before FEM work overlap
resource_batches_before_launch.interpretation: One discriminating numerical sensitivity, not blind continuation; no physical frequency can be inferred from steady iteration periods

resource_batches_before_launch.purpose: R0 and single V2 candidate at Q1.00 on their admitted common coarse grids, new common testbench; initialize from existing fields and execute up to two150-step phases each
resource_batches_before_launch.launch_state: not launched; after D1 diagnosis and separate resource slot
resource_batches_before_launch.stop: If either sample fails original criteria, no automated continuation or curve ranking

resource_batches_before_launch.purpose: Only after admitted D2a, four additional samples at Q.85 and Q1.10 for both configurations

boundary_model_discriminator_if_needed: If D1 fails to isolate linear/coupling effects, prepare common outlet-length sensitivity before interpreting any fine pitch ranking. Current hotspots are ~31-34mm from outlet (~0.12D), with gross outlet recirculation ~10.8% of net flow. Extended testbench requires its own CAD/mesh QA and planned budget; not approved as a background job.
